text:
My solitary and opulent summit

declined toward your shadowed valley,

which neither gold of grain nor freshness of well

nor garrulous aviary sustains.


In your gravitating, sickly light,

the balance of repose broken,

I wander over your fearful spirit

like a shred of ashen mist.


I am free to return to my hillocks

where boyish Eros plays the reed-pipe,

girdled by lambs and shepherds;


but to perpetual exile I am provoked

by the spark of your troubling eyes,

the red curling of your mouth.

translation.title: My Solitary and Opulent Summit
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the sonnet's movement from pastoral freedom into chosen erotic exile.
